:::{#thm-exp-sum}
#### exponential of a sum

The exponential of a sum is equal to the product of the exponentials of the addends:

$$\exp{a+b} = \exp{a} \cd \exp{b}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-exp-sum}
#### Exponential of a sum

With $a = 2$ and $b = 3$,
$\exp{2 + 3} = \exp{5} \approx 148.41$,
and $\exp{2} \cd \exp{3} \approx 7.389 \cd 20.09 \approx 148.41$.

:::
